_purpose: Knobs for Module 102T (Task Tree Planner). Controls whether a user goal gets decomposed into sub-goals (vs the single-shot pipeline), how aggressively, and the per-tree budget. Heuristic-only — no English literals or category names inside module_102t code.

complexity_heuristic._doc: A goal triggers decomposition iff ANY of these signals fire. We deliberately err on the side of NOT decomposing (it costs N×LLM calls) — the operator can force always-decompose via env TASK_TREE_ALWAYS=1.

tree_limits._doc: Hard upper bounds. max_leaves_per_tree exists so a runaway LLM can't spawn a 50-step tree that exhausts the API budget. max_depth is currently 1 (flat tree of leaves) — deeper trees are a future phase.

leaf_pipeline._doc: Behaviour overrides for sub-goal leaves so we don't spam the audit log and don't double-spend reflector tokens. Reflector and skill-creation only run at the ROOT task (the parent); intermediate leaves still get verified + governance-checked.

fallback._doc: When the decomposer LLM fails or returns garbage, we fall back to single-shot mode instead of crashing. This is the same conservative discipline 102B (synthesizer) uses.
